help.title: About bookings
help.overview: A booking puts an order on the calendar, with a start and end time, for work done at an appointment.

sections.title: Each booking
items: Either side of the order can book it while the order is accepted or in progress; one booking per order.
Only the provider, or an administrator, can reschedule it.
Unless you are an administrator, you see only the bookings of your own orders.
